The '''Battle of Tion''' was fought between the [[Kingdom of Cron]] of [[Pirate King/Legends|Pirate King]] [[Xer VIII|Xer]] and the [[Back Spiral]] in the [[Pre-Republic era]], at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tion]].

Following the [[Battle of Chandaar|defeat]] of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ferece]], Xer installed himself as the new [[King of Cron]] and launched a series of campaigns to take control of the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]]. After have conquered the complete Kingdom of Cron and defeated the [[Three Allied Kingdoms]], Xer attacked the worlds of the so-called Back Spiral. After his victores at [[Caluula/Legends|Caluula]] and [[Brigia/Legends|Brigia]], Xer finally defeated the Back Spiral at Tion and built gleaming palaces on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]]. Although his empire reached its greatest extend, one power managed to stand against the Pirate King: the [[Livien League]].<ref name="Xim Week" />
